cohort: Participants were from the prospective mother-child cohort "Rhea" in Crete, Greece, including 642 neonates, 578 of whom had complete follow-up data from birth to 4 years.
finding: High cord blood leptin levels were generally associated with lower weight, height, and BMI from 6 months to 4 years of age, though a reverse association was noted in children born small for gestational age or with rapid infant growth.
